resources.string: Used across the whole app. You can change it later in Settings.
RONDA guards your parents\' phone against scams
Scammers send app files over WhatsApp — an invitation, a delivery receipt, a bill. Once installed, that app can read bank OTP codes.
RONDA checks every new app that arrives from outside the Play Store.
The alert goes to a child or relative\'s phone — not to the person being scammed.
A dangerous app is covered by a RONDA warning until the guardian decides.
RONDA never reads your messages, never asks for SMS permission, and never uses the Accessibility service.
This decides what RONDA does on this phone.
RONDA watches this phone. If a dangerous app is installed, RONDA covers it and tells the guardian.
RONDA sends alerts to this phone when something suspicious shows up on your parent\'s phone.
Once chosen, the role cannot be changed without reinstalling the app.
Shown on your parent\'s phone, as \"Guarded by …\".
This name appears on every screen — for example \"Mum\'s phone\".

The phone will open a Settings page. Turn it on, then come back to RONDA.
RONDA is now protecting this phone.
So RONDA can tell you when a dangerous app is installed.
So RONDA can cover a dangerous app with a warning. RONDA cannot read what is on your screen.
So RONDA knows which app is open. It sees only the app\'s name, never its contents.
So the phone does not shut RONDA down in the background. Without this, RONDA can stop watching without telling anyone.
RONDA never asks for SMS permission, never reads your messages, and never uses the Accessibility service.
Your guardian is watching over this phone. If a dangerous app is installed, RONDA covers it and tells them right away.
